map.公式：承压完整井 K = Q·ln(R/r₀) / (2π·M·s)；潜水完整井: Formulas: confined fully penetrating well K = Q·ln(R/r₀) / (2π·M·s); unconfined fully penetrating well K = 2Q·ln(R/r₀) / (π·(2H−s)·s), where Q is the pumping rate (m³/d) and s the drawdown…
map.承压井：用承压完整井公式由抽水量、降深与影响半径求 K: Confined well: use the confined fully penetrating well formula to get K from the pumping rate, drawdown, and radius of influence
map.潜水井：用潜水完整井公式（考虑(2H−s)）求 K: Unconfined well: use the unconfined fully penetrating well formula (with the (2H−s) term) to get K
map.富水性分级：按 K 值将含水层分为弱/中/强/极强透水，评价导水能力: Aquifer productivity classification: by K value aquifers are classed as weak, medium, strong, or extremely strong permeable, which evaluates their transmissivity
map.R 取值偏差会直接影响 K，建议至少布一个观测孔，不宜直接套经验值: A deviation in R directly affects K, so at least one observation well is recommended rather than applying an empirical value as is
map.影响半径 R 怎么取？: How Is the Radius of Influence R Chosen?
map.可由观测孔实测降深反算，或用经验公式（如库萨金 R=2s√K·H）。R 取值偏差: K can be back-calculated from the drawdown measured in an observation well, or estimated with an empirical formula (such as the Kustakin R=2s√K·H). A deviation in R directly affects K, so at least one observation well is recommended instead of applying an empirical value as is.
map.潜水井为什么公式多 (2H−s)？: Why Does the Unconfined Well Formula Contain (2H−s)?
map.潜水完整井用 Dupuit 假设积分得流量∝(2H−s)·s，H 为含水层厚、s: Integrating the Dupuit assumption for an unconfined fully penetrating well gives flow ∝(2H−s)·s, where H is the aquifer thickness and s the drawdown; as s approaches H the formula breaks down and a partial penetration or numerical method is needed.
